entities.summary: The Zaccaria family was a noble Genoese family that had great importance in the development and consolidation of the Republic of Genoa in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, and whose only surviving branch produced the last ruling dynasty of the Principality of Achaea in Frankish Greece.
